title: Notes and Tasks Android App
tagline: Native Android notes and tasks app with RoomsDB persistence
intro: An Android app for managing notes and tasks with CRUD, pinning, and search, built using Java and RoomsDB (SQLite).
summary: Developed as a university project, this mobile app allowed users to create, edit, pin, and search notes and tasks. RoomsDB (SQLite) ensured structured persistence, while a native UI delivered smooth usability.
features: Task creation, marking as done, and deletion
Native Android interface for smooth UX

sections.title: Description
sections.body: Android notes and tasks app with CRUD, pinning, and search functionality using RoomsDB.

sections.title: Objective / Aim
sections.body: Provide a versatile Android productivity app for managing notes and tasks with persistence and usability.

sections.title: Role & Responsibilities
sections.body: Implemented CRUD flows, integrated RoomsDB, built UI in Android Studio, and added pinning/search features.

sections.title: Impact / Results
sections.body: Showcased Android development and database integration skills through a functional productivity app.
